hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE 'update-snapshots|e2e:update|playwright test.* -u( |$)' && { echo 'Blocked: never update visual baselines to make a test pass. Report the diff instead; a human approves baseline changes.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.md) pnpm exec remark "$f" --quiet --silently-ignore --output >&2 || exit 2 ;; *) pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown --log-level=warn "$f" >&2 || exit 2; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) pnpm exec eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac ;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; jq -e '.stop_hook_active' >/dev/null && exit 0; out=$(pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test --affected --continue --output-logs=errors-only 2>&1) || { echo 'Lint, typecheck or tests failed in affected packages. Fix them before finishing:' >&2; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -c 6000 >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: Running lint, typecheck and tests on affected packages...
